environment.description: Deployed as ECS Fargate task behind an AWS ALB with default settings. The ALB forwards raw HTTP/1.1 connections to the container on port 8080. No additional middleware or WAF is configured. Keep-alive connections are enabled on the ALB target group, allowing connection reuse between the ALB and backend. The proxy handler processes requests sequentially on persistent connections.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default HTTP/1.1 forwarding
